name: small_abstraction
invariant: A single reusable history transformer, defined once, can be applied more than once with different arguments -- demonstrating abstraction beyond direct, one-off event entry.
explanation: Choice(taken, rejected) is the reusable transformer here: `sugar::choice` is defined exactly once (Pop(taken) alongside an explicit Refuse(rejected)) and this fixture applies it twice with two different argument pairs. The two resulting sub-traces are structurally identical in shape (one Pop, one Refuse) and differ only in which objects they name, which is what makes it a genuine abstraction rather than two independently hand-written event sequences.
